feedback: Both findings reflect the same issue: model inferences about current repository state were stated without first checking the authoritative state. (1) The question about whether revision requests need a durable record is already resolved and implemented - reviews.jsonl is append-only, uses the defined six-field record, and existing intakes contain review records; represent it as an existing locked decision with repository evidence, not an open question. (2) focusWorkItemId is NF-2. NF-3 appears in the next-action text because it is the upcoming phase; the next destination and the current focus are different concepts. (3) Any model_inference making a factual claim about current code, canonical state, or shipped repository behavior must be checked against the relevant authoritative artifact before being assigned high confidence; when unchecked, frame it as a hypothesis or question rather than a current-state fact.

Draft 0002 fixed the original corrections but still proposes a canonical risk materially equivalent to RSK-5, and the apply preview shows one new risk would be created. Describing that match as an exact existing canonical risk is therefore internally inconsistent: an exact duplicate would have been skipped by the existing normalized-match behavior. (1) Remove the proposed creation of the duplicate risk. Treat the finding as already represented by RSK-5 and make no canonical risk change for it. (2) Stop describing the match as exact. It is a semantic or paraphrased duplicate that the existing exact-match mechanism correctly surfaced for human review. (3) Review the source-derived findings dropped between drafts 0001 and 0002 (29 down to 10). Restore every relevant source finding removed without a reason tied to my requested corrections. Do not optimize for the old numerical count; preserve complete relevant coverage and explain any intentional omissions. (4) Keep the corrected locked decision about durable revision records. (5) Keep the corrected distinction that focus is NF-2 while NF-3 appears only in the next-action text. (6) Continue requiring repository-state inferences to name the authoritative artifact actually checked.
